sources.entry: clausona by larcane97 - A CLI and TUI for running several Claude Code accounts on one machine. Each account gets its own config directory through a shell hook, keeping its own sign-in and history, while plugins, settings, skills, commands and agents are symlinked to one primary directory.

summary.one_liner: clausona is a CLI and TUI that runs several Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI accounts on one machine, with separate sign-ins while plugins, settings, skills and hooks are shared.
summary.what_it_does: It creates a config directory per account (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or CODEX_HOME) through a shell hook that wraps claude and codex, so `clausona use work` switches accounts without re-login. Plugins, settings, skills, hooks and Codex config.toml are symlinked to a primary directory so setup is shared across profiles. Conversation history stays per account unless merged with `clausona config --merge-sessions`. It reads each account's 5-hour and weekly plan quota from the tool's usage endpoint and can route runs to the account with quota left (`clausona run --route`). It also lists and manages skills, MCP servers and hooks loaded per project, and supports API profiles pointing at Anthropic-compatible endpoints (Claude Code only).
use_cases: switch between personal and work Claude Code accounts
switch between multiple OpenAI Codex CLI accounts
share plugins and settings across accounts
check remaining plan quota across accounts
automatically route runs to the account with quota left
run two accounts side by side in separate terminals
manage skills, MCP servers and hooks per project
how_to_run: macOS/Linux: curl -fsSL <installer URL from README> | bash (requires Node.js >= 20)
Windows PowerShell: irm <installer URL from README> | iex
notable: Separate sign-in and history per account, with shared plugins, settings and skills via symlinks to one primary directory
Plan quota readout for every account, read live from each tool's usage endpoint
Routing by plan quota, with waiting for reset in scripts and directory-based route rules
No daemon or proxy: claude and codex run unmodified after the shell hook sets the environment
Extensions screen and CLI to list, disable, or delete skills, MCP servers and hooks behind backups
caveats: Usage tracking and API profiles are Claude Code only; Codex API profiles are not supported yet
Windows shared files need Developer Mode for symlinks, otherwise some files are copied per account
MCP servers added with `claude mcp add` stay per account and are not shared
Codex session sharing behaves differently on Windows, and codex resume sharing applies on macOS and Linux only
